card.name: Linking words before severe outcomes
card.fires_on: Small linking words in warnings, such as the comma after "however", "require" after "priapism may", and "on" after "depending". They come just before a statement about severity or serious outcomes.

modes.label: After however
modes.description: The comma after "however" when mild symptoms are followed by a more serious consequence.

modes.label: Needing surgery
modes.description: The verb "require" or "requiring" before surgical intervention for priapism.
modes.example: Severe priapism may<< require>> surgical intervention. 5.15

modes.label: Depending on severity
modes.description: The word "on" after "depending" in instructions to withhold a drug according to severity.

card.writes: It adds a push toward continuing with outcome or severity wording and away from diagnosis and screening terms.
card.plain: It marks the point in a warning where the text turns to how serious a problem is or what it leads to.
